# plotwork_render (Data Source)

Renders Plotwork source to a self-contained SVG. Write `svg` wherever the team reads it: an `aws_s3_object`, an `azurerm_storage_blob`, a `google_storage_bucket_object` or a `local_file`. Nothing is stored by Plotwork. Needs the Pro plan or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "plotwork_import" "network" {
  format = "terraform"
  files  = { for f in fileset(path.module, "*.tf") : f => file("${path.module}/${f}") }
}

data "plotwork_render" "network" {
  source = data.plotwork_import.network.source
  scheme = "auto"
}

# Keep the picture next to the architecture docs.
resource "aws_s3_object" "network" {
  bucket       = "acme-architecture"
  key          = "diagrams/network.svg"
  content      = data.plotwork_render.network.svg
  content_type = "image/svg+xml"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) The Plotwork source to draw: from `plotwork_import`, a `.diagram` file, or `templatefile()` filled with module outputs.

### Optional

- `embed_source` (Boolean) Write the source into the SVG's metadata so Plotwork can open it for editing later. Anyone with the file can then read the source. Defaults to false.
- `scheme` (String) `light` (the default), `dark`, or `auto` for one picture that follows the viewer's setting.
- `theme` (String) A colour theme to paint with, over the source's own `theme=`.

### Read-Only

- `height` (Number) The picture's height in pixels.
- `id` (String) The SHA-256 of `svg`.
- `svg` (String) The SVG markup, with an accessible title and description.
- `warnings` (List of String) Quality warnings, one line each with its code, place and hint. They never stop the render.
- `width` (Number) The picture's width in pixels.
